feeds.title: Fashion Mom Blog
feeds.description: The fashion mom decided to create a blog because I needed to express myself and find that fashion and all aesthetic things feel me with great emotions. She loves as well art, sport, and travel. Her blog is about fashion, art, Montreal, and a bit of traveling. She will share with you the moments of my life, my city Montreal, which became my second home, travels, and city girl tips.

feeds.title: At the Immigrant's Table
feeds.description: Wholesome Russian & Jewish recipes reinvented to accommodate allergies and dietary restrictions. Freelance writer, photographer, and brand ambassador. A food and travel blog showcasing immigrant stories and international recipes that help adventurous home cooks explore the world.

feeds.title: PIECE OF PIE
feeds.description: Piece of Pie is a place to share lessons learned while trying to live life to the fullest and find balance for all the pieces of your life. She shares tales of disordered life including ADHD, dyslexia, travel, parenting, lifestyle, nutrition, wellness and more.

feeds.title: Mademoiselle Jules
feeds.description: The author founded Mademoiselle Jules in 2014. What initially started out as a creative outlet, turned into a one-stop luxury lifestyle destination. From fashion and gastronomy to beauty, travel, and more, Mademoiselle Jules is my place to share, inspire and empower women.

feeds.title: Midnight Mom
feeds.description: Lauren is a Montreal mom blogger by night, full-time mom, and entrepreneur by day. She is the mother of Hannah, Alex, and Leo. Her blog started in the wee hours of the night when her daughter Hannah refused to go to bed before midnight. Lauren shares her favorite gear, fashion, food, places, and spaces for children both in Montreal and abroad on her blog.

feeds.title: StaceyAnn Clayton
feeds.description: If you're into beauty, wellness, lifestyle, and quick recipes then you're in for a treat. StaceyAnn Clayton blog contains over 100 blogs that will inspire you to, eat well, live well and trust the process. StaceyAnn Clayton blogs will share journey to living a healthier, and fuller life.

feeds.title: Hey Maca
feeds.description: Maca is a lifestyle blogger living in Montreal, Quebec, and a mama of 2 little cuties, Nico & Olivia. She loves to share joyful moments and discover new places with her little family. On her blog, you'll see lots of yummy food, fashion, and cute things. Lemonades, tons of shoes, origami, and brunch are some of the things that make her smile

feeds.title: Eclectic Spark
feeds.description: I find time between freelancing to complete little house, DIY and decor projects that I post about on this blog, along with travel pics, fashion looks, beauty favourites and all my random, creative endeavours. Eclectic Spark is all about sharing the things I love in life, personal projects and the small whimsies that are found in everyday life.

feeds.title: By Angela Blog
feeds.description: Over the last few years, Angela has really put all of her energy into maintaining a healthy balanced life and trying to figure out exactly what that means. Without even realizing it, this became her passion. This blog is all about lifestyle, looks, wellness, and more.

feeds.title: Lauren Enright
feeds.description: Live Motherhood with more ease and less worry with mindfulness, movement, and meditation. You will thrive in ALL your roles when you FEEL well physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually. Achieve Integrated Wellness.

feeds.title: Joanna Anastasia
feeds.description: Joanna Anastasia on her blog, shares home decor ideas, mindfulness and motherhood essays, and bright lifestyle ideas. Joanna is a mom of two little girls and a psychologist passionate who happens to love cooking, baking, and crafting.

feeds.title: The Snowboard Mom
feeds.description: Valeri is a wife, a mom, a traveler, a snowboarder, and a fitness junkie. With over 25 years of snowboarding experience, the Snowboard Mom runs a Canadian family ski blog and family snowboard blog here to help you make the most of your time on the slopes with the kids!

feeds.title: Tanis Saucier Photography Blog
feeds.description: My passion is photographing the tiny and oh-so-fleeting details of little humans and continuing to capture them as they grow! If you are considering newborn portraits for your little love and new family, contact me while you are pregnant to ensure a spot on my studio calendar!

feeds.title: Kimberly Archambault Photography Blog
feeds.description: Kimberly Archambault is a bilingual adventure photographer curating your perfect family photo experience rooted in Montreal, Canada. This is her journal. All about her latest photography sessions, answers to my most frequently asked questions and educational tips for photographers. Grab a cup of coffee and follow along.
